授業概要
In order to solve environmental and energy problems around the world, knowledge and technology in the three research areas on which our graduate school is based, namely materials, energy and environment, are essential. In this course, eleven lecturers from various fields of expertise will introduce the latest technologies and theories related to energy and environmental issues.
